method: bun bench/perf-gate/rss-marathon.ts: in-process AgentSession, 120 rounds x 3 tool calls, forced compaction every 20 rounds. Idle baseline = post-construction steady state (full GC, async GC settle ~3s, allocator purge); peak = VmHWM via /proc/self/status. Gates: idle <= 150MB, VmHWM <= 800MB.
stopConditionInvoked: Unreachable target: the idle floor of a functional session measurably exceeds the 150MB target after all identified structural cuts.

floorEvidence.idleComposes: compiled code + JIT + allocator retention of ~800 modules required for a functional session (agent loop, pi-ai streaming core, session orchestration, tool implementations, model catalog, auth).
alreadyLazy: extension host API barrel (ConcreteExtensionAPI loads src/index only when an extension instantiates)
orchestrator runtime + structured subagent (lazy inside agent-bridge/orchestrate)
persisted subagent registry (lazy inside fleet messaging)
provider registry: 76 definitions materialize per-id on lookup
bundled catalog: per-provider JSON materializes per lookup; compat/cost/thinking interned (96%/76% dedup)
web search no longer pulls the SDK barrel
pi-tui: zero barrel edges in headless runtime graph (20 files deep-imported); latex tables lazy
model registry full-catalog snapshot is lazy (#hasFullSnapshot) and filtered projections exist
floorEvidence.why150Unreachable: Idle live JS data is only 24MB; the remaining ~165MB is compiled module code and allocator overhead of subsystems a functional session must load. Reaching 150MB requires removing core functionality (tools, streaming, model resolution) from the session graph, not further lazy-loading.

verification.bunCheck: root bun run check (biome + tsgo all workspaces) exit 0
verification.tests: coding-agent 560 pass / 0 fail; ai 41 pass; catalog 6 pass; tui 62 pass; task/extensibility/fleet/browser subsets pass

nextStepsIfResumed: pi-agent-core/pi-ai core code splitting is the only remaining large lever (~40-60MB of compiled core); requires architectural work beyond lazy-loading.
Tool execution isolation (workers) would move per-tool code out of the main process.
Allocator: mimalloc purges transient construction high-water within ~2s of idle; extended settles do not reduce below ~185MB.
